- **Plugin host code**:"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" a process loads code once at startup, so edits need a restart.
- **Plugin front-end assets**: the b"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"rowser swaps assets by fingerprint, so edits need a hot reload or refresh."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This plugin lets the agent decide which case you're in, and what to do next."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"After installation, the agent gains a set of tools and a skill document. The skill loads on demand; "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"you invoke it with a slash command."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Tools"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Read-only** — they change nothing on the host."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Tool | Arguments | What it does | Web | Desktop |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| `dsh_list_instances` | `port` | List the DSH hosts running on this machine. A port counts as DSH o"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"nly when an unauthenticated `GET /` returns the exact DSH body. "Could not probe" and "not DSH" are "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"reported separately. | ✓ | ✓ |
| `dsh_check_auth` | `host`, `port` | Tell "not running" apart from ""},{"id":"p14s4","text":"not authenticated". | ✓ | ✓ |
| `dsh_diagnose_plugin_load` | `package`, `port`, `dshHome` | Check wh"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ether a plugin actually loaded: `bundle` membership, mount form, `loader` tree, with observed eviden"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ce kept separate from inferred evidence. | ✓ | ✓ |
| `dsh_check_effect_mode` | **`change`**: `config"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"` / `bundle-added` / `host-code` / `client-code`, `alreadyInDependencies`, `dshHome` | Tell whether "},{"id":"p14s8","text":"a change takes effect live, needs a restart, or needs a hot reload. It probes the running `profile` "},{"id":"p14s9","text":"instead of guessing. | ✓ | ✗ |
| `dsh_dump_config` | `profile`, `dshHome` | Show what a `profile` re"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"solved to: the composed tree, plus the diagnostics that explain it. | ✓ | ✗ |
| `dsh_sign_cookie` | "},{"id":"p14s11","text":"`host`, `port`, `maxAgeDays`, `dshHome` | Sign a browser-session `cookie` so a script or CLI client "},{"id":"p14s12","text":"can reach your own DSH instance. | ✓ | ✓ |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**Changes state** — the first two swap code or end the host you are debugging."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Tool | Arguments | What it does | Web | Desktop |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `dsh_hot_reload` | exactly one of **`entryId`** / **`module`** / **`serverName`**, plus `dryRun` |"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" Swap a mounted `entry` to the latest code on disk without restarting. The last column is availability by carrier; reasons live under Platform support."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Three common traps:**"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### The skill document behind it"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The skill document lives at `skills/dsh-plugin-debugging/SKILL.md` and carries the full reasoning be"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"hind install forms, credential acquisition, process identification, and isolated instances."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**The tools are accelerators; if a tool's output conflicts with the skill document, the skill docume"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"s are accelerators; if a tool's output conflicts with the skill document, the skill document wins.**"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Install from the Plugins page:**"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Open the **Plugins** page, click **Add plugin** in the upper-right corner, enter `dsh-plugin-debuggi"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"s** page, click **Add plugin** in the upper-right corner, enter `dsh-plugin-debugging`, and install."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"**Install from npm:**"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"**Install from source:**"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"**Notes:**"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Do not skip `pnpm install`**: with a `link:` install, dependencies come from the repository itse"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"lf; skipping it makes the plugin show up as not running and report `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`.
- **Resta"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"rt to take effect**: restart `dsh --profile web` after installing.
- **`link:` and `dsh.bundle` are "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"two separate things**: `link:` only decides whether editing source needs a reinstall; whether the `p"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"atch` layer applies depends on whether the package declares `dsh.bundle`."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"**Requirements:**"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Node `>= 20`, and a DSH version that satisfies the range in package.json."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"**Maintenance rules:**"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The `profile`'s `dependency` and `bundle list` are managed by `dsh plugin add`; do not edit them by "},{"id":"p36s2","text":"hand. Do not create packages under `$DSH_HOME`, and do not run a package manager inside a `profile` "},{"id":"p36s3","text":"ot create packages under `$DSH_HOME`, and do not run a package manager inside a `profile` directory."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Safety and boundaries"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Except for `dsh_restart`, these tools **never restart a process, never rewrite a `profile`, and neve"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"r write to host data**. Tests enforce this rule: as soon as any write targets a host-data path (`pro"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"files` / `sessions` / `storages` / `logs` / `cache` / `attachments` / `backups` / `integrations` / `"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"mcp` / `settings.yaml` / `.credentials.yaml` …), or uses `DSH_HOME` itself as the target, `pnpm run "},{"id":"p38s5","text":"ings.yaml` / `.credentials.yaml` …), or uses `DSH_HOME` itself as the target, `pnpm run test` fails."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"**The only write exception is this plugin's own namespace**, `$DSH_HOME/<package name>/`: only the f"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"irst directory directly under `$DSH_HOME` must exactly match the package name; anything below that i"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"directly under `$DSH_HOME` must exactly match the package name; anything below that is unrestricted."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"**What each one touches:**"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"- **Read-only, no requests**: `dsh_check_effect_mode`, `dsh_diagnose_plugin_load`, `dsh_dump_config`"},{"id":"p41s2","text":". They only read files the instance already has, and they produce no credentials.
- **Read-only, sen"},{"id":"p41s3","text":"ds HTTP**: `dsh_check_auth` connects to the `host:port` you name; `dsh_list_instances` probes loopba"},{"id":"p41s4","text":"ck ports only. Neither sends credentials.
- **Touches the running module tree only**: `dsh_hot_reloa"},{"id":"p41s5","text":"d`, and kills no process.
- **Reads the local signing key**: `dsh_sign_cookie`, to sign a `cookie` f"},{"id":"p41s6","text":"or your own instance. It sends no request, and the `cookie` value is deliberately not returned.
- **"},{"id":"p41s7","text":"Ends the host**: `dsh_restart`, the only irreversible action here."}],"truncated":true}
